guides.title: Discord Rich Presence & OAuth
guides.summary: Client Discord integration covers presence and OAuth. Keep gameplay state and account decisions on the server.

guides.title: Working with Events
guides.summary: Select a client listener by origin: local events, messages from the server, and messages from the CEF browser use different entry points.

guides.title: Creating Your First CEF UI
guides.summary: Build an HTML interface inside a CyberMP CEF browser. Bundle the page assets and exchange events across the client-to-browser bridge.

guides.title: Client Lifecycle & Stages
guides.summary: Register handlers at resource startup and wait for the appropriate game state before operating on the world or player entity.

guides.title: Local Entities
guides.summary: Spawn preview vehicles, pedestrians, or props for one client. Local handles are distinct from server network identifiers.

guides.title: Local Storage
guides.summary: Use client local storage for preferences and interface state within a resource.

guides.title: Network IDs
guides.summary: Resolve the relationship between server network IDs and the underlying game entities as they stream in.

guides.title: Observing Game Methods
guides.summary: Use the client native bridge to observe game methods before or after the original call. The choice of queued or raw observer changes execution timing.

guides.title: Overriding Game Methods
guides.summary: Use the native override API when changing the behavior of an engine call. Check callback shape and original-call handling before wiring an override.

guides.title: Spawning the Player
guides.summary: Wait for the game world and player lifecycle stage before coordinating a spawn with the native bridge.

guides.title: Teleporting the Player
guides.summary: Teleport the client player using native game facilities after the world is ready.

guides.title: Getting started
guides.summary: Set up a dedicated CyberMP server, prepare server.toml and the resources directory, and confirm the server version from the console.

guides.title: Introduction
guides.summary: CyberMP runs JavaScript and Lua resources across dedicated servers and game clients. Client-side code also connects to the embedded browser.

guides.title: Resource Hotreload
guides.summary: Use a resource watcher for script hotreload, refresh changed manifests, and restart the game client for changes to engine archives and compiled scripts.

guides.title: Remote Procedure Calls (RPC)
guides.summary: Pair server and client event senders with listeners for the correct runtime. Carry browser traffic through the client.

guides.title: Setting Up TypeScript
guides.summary: Install the CyberMP types for the intended runtime and build the JavaScript entry point declared by the resource.

guides.title: Adding resource files
guides.summary: List client assets in the resource manifest file array, including archives and CEF assets. Explicitly cover directories containing files.

guides.title: Creating resources
guides.summary: Declare script entry points and asset lists in resource.toml and register the resource with the server.

guides.title: Resource Exports
guides.summary: Use resource exports to call APIs from another loaded resource. Coordinate dependency initialization and cleanup.

guides.title: Interacting with resources
guides.summary: Use the server console to refresh resource discovery and start, stop, or restart a resource.

guides.title: Live updates
guides.summary: Understand how server resources deliver updated client-side files and how that differs from engine asset loading.

guides.title: CDN
guides.summary: Host the packaged client resource files on a CDN when supported. Repack and upload after changing content or its manifest.

guides.title: Creating Commands
guides.summary: Register server commands with a player context and explicit argument and permission handling.

guides.title: World Entities: Objects, Peds, and Pickups
guides.summary: Manage authoritative world entities such as objects, pedestrians, and pickups and observe their lifecycle.

guides.title: Working with Events
guides.summary: Use the server listener appropriate to a game event or message sent by a client.

guides.title: Working with Hashes
guides.summary: Check the expected hash kind before resolving an appearance, native resource path, or TweakDB record on the server.

guides.title: Entity Metadata & Synchronization
guides.summary: Choose the scope and synchronization behavior of metadata for a player, entity, or server-global value.

guides.title: Working with Players
guides.summary: Work with player connection, lookup, and lifecycle from the server runtime.

guides.title: Working with Vehicles
guides.summary: Create and manage server vehicles and check seat and ownership behavior separately.
